form_title: 2010 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5)

reports.notes: Handwritten all-caps (the same filer's 6/14/2010 report, key e0c17755, was typed). A ZERO-ACTIVITY PERIOD: every Column A cell and every line 3-7 cell is the filer's slashed-zero glyph (a circle with a stroke through it), transcribed as 0 at medium confidence; Column B carries the unchanged year-to-date 2003.75 on both lines, which matches the prior report's totals exactly. The 'Is this report an amendment?' Yes and No boxes are BOTH left unchecked - is_amendment is '' (blank, not 'No'). REPORT DATE DISAGREES WITH THE PORTAL LABEL: the signature date is unmistakably '7/13/10' (cropped and enlarged to confirm the leading 7), while the clerk's received stamp reads AUG 13 and index.csv's reporting_period says 'Campbell - 08/13/10'; the page value is transcribed. Office Seeking reads 'COUNTY RECORDER', agreeing with index.csv. The Page/of, Last Name and Date of Report boxes on the summary page were all left blank.

itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-19 wave B2 utah, chunk r2_02b)

contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 1 TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, written as a SLASHED ZERO (read 0 under the repo zero-glyph ruling), which is matched by Schedule A's OWN printed 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Contributions Received', both also slashed zeros
contributions.detail: Schedule A (p3) is a printed, retained page whose 16 underline rows are ALL BLANK — no date, no name, no address, no amount on any ruled line. Zero itemized rows sum to 0.00, which equals the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell (Column A line 1, a slashed zero) AND the schedule's own two printed totals (both slashed zeros, confirmed by a 900 dpi tight crop of pct:78,83,22,9@p3, which rendered the printed labels 'Subtotal for this page $' and 'Total Contributions Received' each followed by a hand-drawn slashed-zero glyph). Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints 2003.75 and is NOT summed as an increment (utah is a per-period regime): it carries the money this filer raised in earlier 2010 periods, which this zero-activity report does not itemize. The p2 balance ladder is internally consistent and closes at zero: line 3 (slashed zero) + line 4 (slashed zero) = line 5 (slashed zero); line 5 - line 6 (slashed zero) = line 7 (slashed zero).

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, written as a SLASHED ZERO (read 0), matched by Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Expenditures Received', both slashed zeros
expenditures.detail: Schedule B (p4) is a printed, retained page whose 16 underline rows are ALL BLANK. Zero itemized rows sum to 0.00 = the cover's promoted per-period Column A cell = the schedule's own printed page subtotal = its printed total. The 900 dpi tight crop of pct:78,83,22,9@p4 rendered 'Subtotal for this page $' followed by a clearly slashed zero and the 'Total Expenditures Received' line carrying a second slashed zero. Column B YTD expenditures print 2003.75 and are never summed as an increment.

itemized.in_kind_convention: not applicable — the schedules carry no entries at all, so monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind give the identical sum (0.00) and both close on the slashed-zero Column A. Neither schedule page prints a separate in-kind column, and the cover prints no in-kind line.
itemized.escalation_note: One escalation, for legibility of the four nil marks on the two schedule pages: make_snippet.py --dpi 900 on pct:78,83,22,9@p3 and pct:78,83,22,9@p4. Both crops rendered the printed 'Subtotal for this page $' and 'Total ... Received $' labels each followed by a hand-drawn oval with a stroke through it — a SLASHED ZERO, not a bare dash and not an empty cell. Under the repo ZERO-GLYPH RULING (GOTCHAS 2026-08-02) a slashed zero denotes the digit zero, so these are printed zeros and the sides are a real absence of entries rather than unfilled cells.

geometry.provenance: printed-rule detection on the rendered page (scripts/campaign_finance/rowbands.py, raw-render frame): per-page frame = the Amount column band x one measured band per printed table row; a row's box is their intersection, in pct of the page as poppler renders it (rotation included)

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE CANDIDATE: 'RODNEY D. CAMPBELL' (all-caps hand printing) — index.csv names NO candidate for this row (the 2008-2018 county_static listing grouped filings by office), so the page face governs and is offered to the coordinator for office_overrides.csv promotion into the EMPTY channel cell. Party printed 'REPUBLICAN'; Office Seeking hand-written 'COUNTY RECORDER'; residence city Provo, UT (street address printed on the cover is deliberately NOT carried — this era is published unredacted and the address is plainly visible; PRIVACY reduces it at read time). legacy_colAB variant, 4 pages, each classified from its OWN printed header: p1 COVER ('2010 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES', Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5), p2 SUMMARY PAGE (located by its printed 'SUMMARY PAGE' header; it happens to sit at the expected p2 ordinal for this variant), p3 SCHEDULE A ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED, p4 SCHEDULE B ITEMIZED EXPENDITURES MADE. THIS IS A ZERO-ACTIVITY PERIOD, NOT AN UNREAD FILING: every Column A cell on the summary page (lines 1-7) is a slashed zero, and BOTH schedule pages exist, are printed, and carry no entry on any of their 16 ruled lines. BOTH SIDES ARE THEREFORE `empty-schedule`, not `no-schedule-page` and not `withheld`. WHAT SCHEDULE A ACTUALLY PRINTS BESIDES THE BLANK GRID: a single large hand-drawn mark — an oval with a diagonal stroke through it, spanning roughly the 7th to 9th ruled lines across the Name-of-Contributor and Mailing-Address columns. It is a void/strike annotation over empty ruled lines, not an entry: it carries no date, no name and no amount, and no ruled line under or around it bears any writing. Schedule B carries no such mark and is simply blank. REPORT TYPE: '30 Days after the Primary Election (if eliminated at the Primary)' is the checked box. THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS LEFT WHOLLY UNANSWERED — neither the Yes nor the No box is ticked and the 'Date of Report' rule beside Yes is blank; that is an honest BLANK, never read as 'No' (Addendum A4 precedent). A DATE DISCREPANCY WORTH RECORDING, transcribed as printed and not adjudicated: the candidate signed and dated the Report Verification '7/13/10', while the clerk's 'For Office Use Only' stamp reads 'AUG 13 AM 10:51' and the county's own filename encodes 081310. The filer appears to have written the month of the preceding month; both figures are kept verbatim and neither was corrected. The page header box (Page __ of __, Candidate's Last Name, Date of Report) is left blank by this filer on all three of pages 2-4, so foliation gives no independent page count — consistent with Addendum A4's finding that foliation is unreliable here.
